## Concepts

- Open Access
- Open Source
- Metadata - It is often described as data about data. It is
  information that describes a dataset, such as who created it, when and
  how it was collected and what each variable means, so that others can
  find, understand, and reuse the data.
- License (as a verb, providing access to ejournals, databases, etc)
- Creative Commons License
- Trustworthy Digital Repository (TDR)
- COUNTER usage statistics
- Peer review
- SAFES Data
- FAIR Principles
- CARE Principles
